sara_support: Customer acme-corp (proj: acme-prod) — says Console > Billing shows $150 trial credit grant (visible on org and project pages) but their API requests using project service token are still being billed. Customer reports credits not being applied starting 2025-11-12. Service token (truncated) sk-prod-ACME-XXXX. Can we triage? They need a quick fix or manual offset.
eli_engineer: Sorry — can you paste the customer/org id and the exact project/servicekey being used? Also, did they rotate tokens recently?
noah_billing: Quick note: our billing pipeline applied the org-level grant on 2025-11-12 02:34 UTC (job metering-grant-v2). But that only writes to org_credit table; per-service application happens on invoice generation / usage reconciliation. Might be a reconciliation gap.
sara_support: Org id is org_189482, project id proj_acme_prod. Customer says they haven't rotated service keys. I ran a quick curl from my laptop: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-ACME-XXXX" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/requests -d '{"model":"gpt-3.5"}'` and got a 200 response body but billing header shows `X-Remaining-Credits: 0` and later invoice shows a charge. They pasted a screenshot.
eli_engineer: Can you run the usage endpoint and paste the raw json? `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-ACME-XXXX" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage` — we need to see billing_scope on the service token. Example response we expect: `{"service_key":"proj_acme_prod","billing_scope":"project","credits_applied":true}`. If `billing_scope` is missing or `credits_applied:false` that's our smoking gun.
sara_support: Pasted output (sanitized):
```
{
  "service_key": "proj_acme_prod",
  "billing_scope": null,
  "credits_applied": false,
  "invoices": [{"id":"inv_8271","amount_cents":4500,"applied_credits_cents":0}]
}
```
eli_engineer: That matches the suspicion — token isn't carrying billing_scope, so the runtime treats it as a billable request w/o project-level credits. Two likely routes: 1) connector that backfills token metadata failed for a subset of tokens when we flipped the credits-service to v2 on 2025-11-12, or 2) token was re-hashed/rotated and hash mismatch prevents lookup.
noah_billing: I can run a manual usage-reconcile for org_189482 that will re-attach eligible credits to affected invoices. Scheduling it now — ETA ~30m. I also see a warning in the reconcile logs: `WARN: token_lookup miss for token_hash f7c3..` which aligns with a hash mismatch.
kim_pm: Customer impact: they reported tests failing and a dev environment charged unexpectedly. Please confirm scope and remediation timeline so I can communicate with the customer success rep.
deploy_bot: [metering-reconcile] job completed: run_id=run-20251113-04, processed=12,400 rows, fixes_applied=0, warnings=1, duration=00:02:18
sara_support: Thanks — can you escalate to infra? If it's a connector bug we need a hotfix or migration. I'll tell the account team we'll have a manual resync in ~30m.
eli_engineer: I'll check connector logs for `credits-service-v2` on 2025-11-12 02:30-03:00 UTC. Likely root cause: the legacy token indexing lambda failed to write `billing_scope` after the v2 grant writes. Temporary mitigation: billing can set a project-level override in the admin console for proj_acme_prod until we patch.
noah_billing: Manual resync started for org_189482 at 2025-11-13T15:02:00Z. I'll post final results here. If resync can't find token due to hash mismatch we can run a lookup by project id and apply credits to outstanding invoices directly.
sara_support: Customer notified — they want the charge reversed if resync can't auto-fix.
eli_engineer: Action items: (1) noah run resync and report rows fixed, (2) infra check token-indexer error window and restart/replay missed events, (3) engineering to prepare a short patch to make reconcile tolerant of missing `billing_scope` by falling back to project id lookup for backfills.
noah_billing: Resync completed: resynced_invoices=3, credits_applied_cents=15000, notes=\"applied org grant to 3 invoices; two invoices required manual project-id lookup due to token_hash misses\". I submitted a reversal for the customer for the two invoices that were not auto-applied.
sara_support: Customer confirmed credits reflected and refunded for two invoices. They said they can proceed. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
kim_pm: Please keep this ticket open until infra confirms root cause and we have a PR for the patch.
eli_engineer: Will follow up with logs + PR link. Closing interim loop but leaving ticket open. :white_check_mark:
